import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot a bar chart to show the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud, order=credit_fraud['transaction_type'].value_counts().index)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot a histogram to show the distribution of transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.histplot(credit_fraud['amount'], bins=20, kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend(title='KDE')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, append=True)

# Plot a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between amount and hour of day
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud)
plt.title('Relationship between Hour of Day and Transaction Amount')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, append=True)
